title: Minimum Total Cost to Process All Elements
summary: Start with k resource units and process array demands left to right, consuming each demand. Whenever needed, purchase another k units; the first purchase costs one, the second two, and so forth. Return the minimum total purchase cost modulo1000000007. The initial k units are free and the refill size stays fixed.
exampleStatus: Author and independently check examples; no source examples copied into public presets.
